facility.name: Bright Stars Cdc
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Skill Classes,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1306 FORESTBURG DR, HOUSTON, TX, 77038

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan: The emergency plan did not include a reunification plan for parents and children in an emergency for either an evacuation or lock down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §746.5202(5))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: The emergency preparedness plan did not include the continuation of care procedures.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan did not include how children 24 months and younger and/or with mobility restrictions will be evacuated. The plan also did not discuss the orderly movement of children and staff regarding a shelter in-place or lock down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Two school age children did not have the required school information in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child's record did not contain a health statement after being enrolled for over 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: 18 children admission information did not have the swim/water activity permission and required information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912): 6 personnel records did not contain Form 2912 Pre-Employment Affidavit for new hires hired after 9/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Training records were not made available to review and evaluate during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The list of employees leaving the center in 2024 was not submitted by the deadline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The background check list had not been updated within the last 3 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: I observed a sink with cleaning supplies stored underneath with no child safety lock.  The items were marked  "Keep out ot the reach of children".  This was corrected at the time of the inspection when all the items were removed from the cabinet and placed in an inaccessible area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: 9 children were observed in a classroom without caregiver taking a nap ages 2-3yrs old. A 14months child was observed left in a pack and play in a classroom without supervision. 9 children were observed in the cafeteria without proper supervision. The caregiver was in the kitchen preparing snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: During the walk through of the facility the infant room was observed without adequate lighten. CCR and Caregiver was unable to determine the number of children in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The background checks had not been validated in the last 3 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The center did not report the number of employees leaving employment the previous year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23,  2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who  left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, 2  lacked a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Of the 10 children records evaluated, 8 lacked the address for the children's doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Based on the number of deficiencies cited, the director is not operating the center in compliance with Minimum Standards, rules and laws.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The list of "Current Employees" is not up to date. Please post an up to date list by 11/30/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: The following supervision issues were observed:  1. A group of school age children were left unsupervised while the caregiver went to the front door to retrieve children that been dropped off by the van driver. The children exited the van and entered the building unsupervised.  2. A child was left unsupervised in the cafeteria while another group of children was being retrieved.  3. Children were allowed to enter the building and go to the playground unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Of the 10 children records evalauted, four lacked the address for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Children were observed watching television during snack time. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: A caregiver did not know how many children she was responsible for, Caregiver must know the number of children in their care at all times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Seven staff did not complete an orientation that covered the following topics:  1. Administering medications  2. Preventing and responding to  emergencies related to food allergies  3. Building and physical premises safety  4. Handling and storing of hazardous materials  5. Precautions in transporting children
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, two lacked the name and telephone number of the school the child attends.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: A caregiver was observed washing the hands of 2 year old with a wet papertoiwel. Children of this age must wash their hands with running water and soap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink: Caregivers are washing the hands of infants who are old enough to reach for running water with a soapy papertowl. Once the child is old enough to reach for running water, the child must wash their hands with running water and soap
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink (26 TAC §746.3421(b))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Toddlers - Outdoor Play: Toddler age children are only going outside twice a day. Toddler wage children must be given the opportunity for outside play twice a day, weather permitting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Toddlers - Outdoor Play (26 TAC §746.2507(1))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies is lacking the following information:  1. Safe sleep policy to infants 0-12 months old.  2. Promotion of physical activity and outside play  3. The contact information for the local Licensing office is incorrect  4. Inform parents that a comfortable place for a mother or breastfeed is available and breast milk can be provided.  5. Inform parents that the center is required to receive annual training regarding child abuse and neglect.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Of the nine staff records evaluated, all lacked training in the following health and safety topics for their respective training years:  1. Emergency Preparedness  2. Communicable diseases and immunizations  3. Administering medications  4. Preventing, controlling and responding to emergencies related to food allergies  5. Understanding Building and physical premises safety  6. Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials    The caregivers will need to receive make-up training hours. The make-up training hours will not count towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The written activity plan does not include the opportunity for outside play twice a day. CHildren mist be given two opportunities for outside play each day, weather permitting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: A daily report sheet is not being provided to parents of all infants in care. An infant is defined as a child age 0-17 months. Parents of all infants must be provided a daily report sheet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director lacked training in the following health and safety topics for the September 2020-September 2021 training year.  1. Emergency Preparedness  2. Communicable diseases and immunizations  3. Administering medications  4. Preventing, controlling and responding to emergencies related to food allergies  5. Understanding Building and physical premises safety  6. Handling, storing and disposing of hazardous materials    You will need to receive make up training hours. The make-up training hours will not count towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))
